title: FlyingStart: Learned Cross-Token Warm Starts for Fixed-Point Decoding in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurrent-depth language models generate each token by iterating a shared block of layers until its hidden state converges. Inference methods for these models decide when to stop the iteration, yet every token still starts from random noise and pays the full cost of converging. We show that where the iteration starts is a second, independent lever. A token's fixed point is predictable from the state at which the previous token stopped, after a learned change of coordinates, and we introduce FlyingStart, a linear warm start that is fitted in closed form on the frozen model and costs under 5% of one loop. The iteration and its stopping rule are unchanged, so the exit criterion certifies the same distance to the fixed point from any start: a better start removes loops at unchanged accuracy. On Huginn-0125, FlyingStart matches the accuracy of the strongest training-free baseline with 14--19% fewer decoding layers, raises batched throughput b

translated_title: FlyingStart：面向递归深度语言模型不动点解码的学习型跨Token热启动方法
translated_abstract: 递归深度语言模型通过反复迭代一个共享的层块来生成每个Token，直到其隐藏状态收敛。针对这类模型的推理方法只决定何时停止迭代，而每个Token仍然从随机噪声开始迭代，并为此付出完整收敛过程的代价。我们证明，迭代的起始点是第二个独立的优化杠杆。在学习到的坐标系变换之后，一个Token的不动点可以从上一个Token停止迭代时的状态预测出来。基于此，我们提出FlyingStart——一种线性热启动方法，它在冻结模型上以闭式解拟合，成本不到一次循环的5%。迭代过程及其停止规则保持不变，因此退出准则从任意起点都能保证到不动点的相同距离：更好的起点能在精度不变的情况下减少循环次数。在Huginn-0125模型上，FlyingStart以减少14%–19%的解码层数达到了最强免训练基线的精度，同时提升了批量推理吞吐量……
tldr: 提出FlyingStart方法，利用上一个Token停止时的状态经闭式解拟合的线性变换来热启动下一个Token的迭代，在精度不变的前提下将递归深度语言模型的解码循环层数减少14%–19%。
en_tdlr: FlyingStart introduces a learned, closed-form linear warm start that predicts each token's fixed point from the previous token's stopping state, cutting decoding loops in recurrent-depth language models by 14–19% at unchanged accuracy.
